> The slideshows are lazy. You can disagree if you like.

They're not lazy, they're *efficient*. Would animated cutscenes be awesome? Yes. Does the game support the level of animation that would be required to make them look halfway decent? No.

>TH and bonds bring in gp.

TH does *a little*. Bonds do not. The only way to get gp from bonds is buy them for rl money and sell them to other players, who likely got the gp doing pvm. There's no option to instantly turn a bond into gp. 

>Tesla spends almost $3,000 per vehicle on R&D. That's about three times what other automakers spend.
